title: Cash Pickup Name-Correction Fee: Discount for Senders Who Use Mobile Wallet
content:
**What is the discount?** It is an amount taken off the fee for a recipient-name correction on a Cash Pickup transfer when the sender also sends Mobile Wallet transfers.

**What is counted?** The Mobile Wallet credits sent for the sender, that is, the credit-sent entries on the sender's Mobile Wallet transfers. Only credits dated less than twelve whole months before the day of the correction are counted.

**How much is taken off?**

| Mobile Wallet credits sent in that window | Discount (USD) |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 0.60 |
| at least 1 but fewer than 6 | 0.30 |
| none | nothing |

**How is it taken off?** The discount is taken off the name-correction fee as a whole, meaning the tier's fee together with anything added to it. The fee never falls below zero, and the result is rounded half up to the cent.

**Hypothetical cases.**
- 6 Mobile Wallet credits sent in the window: 0.60 off.
- 2 credits in the window: 0.30 off.
- Credits only older than twelve whole months: nothing off.
